lines.cap: Agentic AI is transforming how enterprises run and grow.
But your AI is only as ready as your enterprise data is.
Tables with cryptic names.
Systems that don't talk to each other.
Documents no one has indexed.
So your AI can't use it.
Solix Enterprise AI gets your data ready for AI.
So you can understand it, ask it anything,
build on it, and put it to work.
Data Sense makes sense of all your data, structured and unstructured.
It drafts the business meaning, and your experts review it.
Knowledge graphs for your applications and cloud platforms
get you started in minutes.
And a steward's worklist keeps your experts in the loop, ranked by what matters most.
Here's what sets Solix apart.
One knowledge graph that connects meaning across all your applications.
The same supplier in three systems becomes one record you can trust.
One shared meaning, everywhere.
No migration. Your records stay where they are.
Data Ask answers questions in plain language,
across structured and unstructured data,
grounded in your business context,
with every answer cited.
Then the people who know your business take over.
They describe the application they need,
and AI Warehouse builds it on governed, version-tracked data.
Your AI, on your data.
Agentic goes further. Just describe the work you need done.
Agentic AI builds it, tests it, and runs it.
Less manual work, more done every day.
And it works with what you already have.
Any LLM.
Any application.
Any data platform.
It fits right into your existing stack.
Solix Enterprise AI.
Put AI in the hands of your business.
